key.name: timezone
key.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. UTC, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo) or fixed UTC offset (e.g. +08:00, -05:00) used by the independent clock.

key.name: format
key.description: Format string passed to GLib.DateTime.format() (strftime syntax), such as %H:%M, %Z %H:%M, or %m-%d %H:%M:%S.

key.name: label-prefix
key.description: Optional custom text prepended before the formatted clock output.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which section of the GNOME Shell top bar hosts the clock: left, center, or right.

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position index within the selected top bar box
key.description: Index within the selected panel box (e.g. 0 places it at the start, 1 places it right after the first item).
